scope.objective: Make persisted JSONL telemetry detect content mutation, insertion, deletion, duplication, and reordering, and bind each completed evaluation report to the exact companion trace, without adding a secret, dependency, signer, external collector, or production-authenticity claim.
forbidden_work: add an HMAC key, signing key, certificate, credential, paid service, dependency, external collector, or real-infrastructure connector
claim origin authentication, hostile-writer resistance, immutable storage, non-repudiation, or full RFC 5848 conformance

change agent outcomes, retrieval, decision context, scenario truth, model access, MCP authority, operator authentication, approval semantics, capabilities, executor actions, or synthetic state transitions
rewrite or delete failed, stale, superseded, or historical trace evidence
change repository visibility, access, or ownership
reversible_actions: freeze and validate a project-authored trace-integrity contract before runtime implementation
add deterministic SHA-256 event sequencing, hash continuity, fail-closed append validation, and evaluation-report binding
run development, held-out, regression, package, real-surface, clean-clone, and release verification
version, commit, push, review, merge, publish, and verify only after every gate passes
stop_conditions: core thesis change or security-boundary weakening
a secret or external trust anchor becomes necessary
the candidate cannot distinguish the frozen corruption cases or cannot verify the real persisted trace
the candidate or shipment cannot be verified

units.purpose: Run public v0.0.15, inspect its evaluation and trace, and prove one telemetry-integrity weakness without mutating released evidence.
Gate official sources and freeze exact integrity, corruption-detection, anchoring, recovery, and non-claim requirements before candidate implementation.
Implement one bounded hash-continuity and completed-evaluation binding improvement without changing model or execution authority.
Reveal the frozen held-out cases once and run every prior source, package, API, MCP, state, telemetry, dashboard, and clean-clone gate.
Version, package, review, merge, publish, and verify the bounded checkpoint only if every gate passes.
